test_space: Schwartz space S(R) in the centered logarithmic coordinate
derivative_arrow: each derivative g^(k) is the Schwartz-topology limit of finite difference combinations of translates
hermite_arrow: g^(k)=(-1)^k He_k(x)g(x); Hermite-Gaussian functions span a dense subspace of S(R)
density: the finite linear span of all translates of one Gaussian is dense in S(R)
positivity_transfer: if q is a continuous Hermitian form on S(R) and every finite translate Gram matrix is positive semidefinite, then q is nonnegative on the translate span and hence on all S(R)
widths: varying Gaussian widths are not needed for abstract density, but may be needed to match the materialized arithmetic kernel parameterization
acceptance_test: Identify the materialized arithmetic two-variable kernel with the Gaussian translate Gram matrices of a continuous completed Weil form and prove their PSD.
